entry.title: Cryptanalysis of Three Quantum Money Schemes
entry.subtitle: Andriyan Bilyk; Javad Doliskani; Zhiyong Gong · 2022-05-21 (v1); v2 2022-10-29
entry.summary: Polynomial-time quantum algorithm for the Aaronson-Christiano hidden-subspace hard problem; polynomial-time cloning attack on Zhandry 2017 multivariate-hash money; reduction for Kane-Sharif-Silverberg quaternion scheme (abstract).
